 Key facts: MSTR falls 36%; $65 Sell call; MSCI exclusion; 850,849 BTC
 Less than 1 min read MSTR MSTR fell about 4% on Nov. 18 to $93, down 36% since Nov. 4. Strategy bought $228.1 million in STRC, raised $244.7 million through stock sales, and held 850,849 BTC as of Nov. 15. 
 3 sources 
 Monness Crespi cut MSTR to Sell from Neutral and set a $65 target, citing weak Bitcoin, high leverage and dilution that may erode the premium on its Bitcoin holdings. 
 Stocktwits 
 Strategy Inc Class A (MSTR) shares have fallen more than 50% over the past year and faced pressure after MSCI announced plans to exclude the shares from its equity indices. 
 CryptoProwl 
 Monness Crespi Hardt downgraded Strategy Inc Class A (MSTR) from Neutral to Sell.
